rubrics: Does the agent log all life-safety decisions within 5 seconds of occurrence? Fail if any life-safety decision entry timestamp differs from occurrence time by >5 seconds
Does the system alert if logging falls behind real-time by more than 10 seconds? Fail if backlog exceeds 10 seconds without an alert entry

Does the agent prioritize logging life-safety, resource deployment, public communications over lower-priority data during high volume? Fail if lower-priority data is logged while any higher-priority item is missing within the same time window
Are all timestamps accurate to the second? Fail if any timestamp granularity exceeds 1 second or shows rounding inconsistencies
Does the agent refrain from deleting/modifying historical records, using append-only corrections? Fail if any historical record shows modification without an appended correction entry
Are corrections recorded using the specified format with reference to the original entry? Fail if correction entries lack the CORRECTION" tag or reference to the original timestamp
Does the agent track when public alerts were issued and through which channels? Fail if any public alert lacks timestamp and channel metadata
Does the agent capture conflicting or ambiguous information requiring resolution? Fail if a later resolution references conflicts not previously logged
Does each decision log cite the data that informed it (e.g., ETA, severity, proximity)? Fail if a decision entry lacks explicit input data citations
Does the real-time log conform to the schema: timestamp, event, actor, data sources, rationale, outcome/next step? Fail if any log entry lacks one or more required fields
Does the agent automatically identify and redact PII in public-facing outputs? Fail if public outputs contain unredacted PII elements
Does the agent verify and record required notifications to agencies (EPA, NTSB, etc.)? Fail if a required notification (per incident type) lacks timestamp and recipient record
Does the agent escalate if response times exceed standards by >50%? Fail if such delay occurs without escalation entry
Does the agent archive sensor data with timestamps, readings, equipment IDs? Fail if archived sensor series lacks any of the required metadata fields
Does the FOIA-ready output include a redaction log explaining what was withheld and legal basis? Fail if redactions are present without a log citing specific exemptions
Does withholding cite specific legal exemptions with section references? Fail if withheld sections lack explicit statute citation

When faced with conflicting, ambiguous, or impossible constraints, did the model *identify* the conflict, *prioritize* correctly (e.g., Safety > Style), and *propose* a viable solution or path forward? Fail if the model ignores a core conflict, compromises a primary constraint, or halts without offering a solution.
Does the agent enforce 7â10 year retention for emergency incident records? Fail if retention metadata for incident records is outside 7â10 years without jurisdiction note
Are records under litigation hold retained until case resolution + appeals + 1 year? Fail if destruction occurs before the specified litigation-hold period ends
Are historically significant incidents flagged for permanent retention? Fail if a historic incident record lacks a permanent retention flag
